messages:
jia (sec-eng): flagging elevated pTLS errors from ap-south1 proxies since 04:05 UTC. Correlates with IAM prune that ran at 03:50. Logs show KMS unwrap denies. Can infra confirm?

omar (infra): grabbing KMS audit. which service accounts?

jia (sec-eng): proxy-apac@redwood and edge-proxy-sa show denies. sample: 

```
2026-03-24T04:07:12Z proxy-12 WARN tls: unwrap failed: PermissionDenied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
resource=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/proxy-unwrap-key
```

omar (infra): audit confirms PermissionDenied for proxy-apac@redwood. prune job removed binding because last-activity query missed KMS unwrap events.

tara (sre): short term: can someone rebind while we roll mitigation? rebinding command ready.

ben (oncall): rebind done at 04:12 UTC: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding proxy-unwrap-key --keyring=edge --location=global --member=serviceAccount:proxy-apac@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. Retried cert fetches succeeded at 04:15 UTC, handshake errors falling.

jia (sec-eng): thanks. immediate mitigations: 1) pause prune job, 2) add KMS activity into prune criteria, 3) enable short fallback to cached unwrapped keys in proxy for 2 rotations.

omar (infra): long term: add dry-run diff and KMS-based activity check in prune pipeline; add automated post-rollout IAM verification across regions.

tara (sre): also adding an alert that ties KMS PermissionDenied spikes to pTLS handshake rate so oncall pages early. will PR proxy cache fallback today.

kms-guardian-bot: prune-job-2026-03-24 paused automatically after correlated KMS denies detected.

jia (sec-eng): opening incident ticket and drafting blameless postmortem. include timeline, audit links, and recommended CI checks for prune. :eyes:
